side.description: +1 the left ear (mirrors the outline, yaws +yaw_deg), -1 the right ear

ear_length.description: Root to tip length of the ear

ear_width.description: Width of the ear at its widest

thickness.description: Overall depth from the rounded back to the front rim

back_round.description: How strongly the back domes; stepped down if the kernel refuses it

rim_margin.description: Solid border left around the recessed inner face, as a fraction of the outline

pocket_depth.description: How deep the inner face is recessed below the rim

rim_radius.description: Distance of the ear's root from the bowl's centre (Z) axis

rim_height.description: Height of the ear's root above Z = 0

yaw_deg.description: Yaw about Z from +X; mirrored in sign by side, never copied unmirrored
